reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: §6(a) allows termination for convenience on 15 days' notice with no exit payment, §6(b) limits Customer's exposure on breach termination to fees/expenses actually incurred or earned, and §3 compensation is pure time-and-materials with no minimum commitment.
No liquidated damages, penalty, kill fee, or minimum/early-termination charge payable by the Customer appears in the cited text, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs) is met.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline and no counterparty comment were proposed; the redline is byte-identical to the original and no deterministic checks failed.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes this is retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue; no over-flagging.
